scope: Read-only source audit; no freezer execution or clean-build acceptance claimed.
confirmed: Requires completed PASS clean custody and an unchanged source manifest.
Every accepted module/data/control pin and copied clean-custody record is rechecked in SOURCE before copying and in both SOURCE and READY after copying.
Manifest and custody snapshots are included among the pinned files.
Fresh directory/archive creation retains working evidence and all prior records.
Cache directories are excluded; retained symlinks and known compiled products, including compound Lean and Windows artifact extensions, are rejected.
Every copy is hash-checked; ZIP entry census, count, uniqueness, safe relative paths and CRC are checked.
Every decompressed ZIP payload, including PACKAGE_FILES.json, is checked against the frozen bytes/hash.
The final receipt pins archive and manifest hashes; directory files and archive are marked read-only.
execution_gate: Do not execute until collector has accepted the final exact coherent closure; keep the public repository unchanged.
